lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Dang it, I can't get him out of the ring!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: I guess that's what I should expect from the son of Kakarot.

lines.speaker: Goten
lines.text: Baby shark, doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo! Baby shark, doo-doo-doo-doo-doo-doo!

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Okay, how about we get a little spicier?

lines.speaker: Goku
lines.text: Aw, hey, Gohan, you taught him how to dodge. That's great.

lines.speaker: Goten
lines.text: Wait, does that mean we can use pew-pews?

lines.speaker: Trunks
lines.text: Dude, you're not even saying it right. It's Kame-ha!

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: Wait, even if you say it wrong, it still works? Then why say it at all?

lines.speaker: Videl
lines.text: Oh, come on, he knows I love him. You know I love you, the Great Saiyaman!

lines.speaker: Vegeta
lines.text: Seriously, though, who put that do-rag on him?
